summary: Implemented the parsel 1.9.1 skeleton under parsel/: utils (flatten, iflatten, extract_regex, shorten), xpathfuncs (setup, set_xpathfunc, has-class), csstranslator (::text and ::attr pseudo-elements, css2xpath, and a class matcher that keeps the concat-only form expected by the tests despite cssselect 1.6), and selector (root parsing with JSON auto-detection, XPath/CSS/JMESPath querying, get/re/remove/drop, namespaces). The last full-suite run (default target) gave 341 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed, exit 0.
